heading: Careers
intro: Booth rentals available — contact for more info!
body: Empyrean Beauty is always interested in talking with stylists who take their craft seriously. We keep a small, senior room: sustainable product, professional tools, and guests who book ahead. If you hold a current Texas cosmetology license and want a chair in a parlor that lets you build your own book, we'd like to meet you.

openings.title: Booth Rental — Stylist
openings.description: A full station in the parlor. Set your own hours and pricing, keep your own clientele, and work alongside a team that shares your standards.

openings.title: Booth Rental — Color Specialist
openings.description: A dedicated station for balayage, highlighting and correction work. Ideal for a licensed colorist with an established following looking for a professional home.

cta.heading: Interested?
cta.body: Send us a note and Kayla will get back to you personally.
